page_title: TOU 1-1 PAR | Toulouse v Paris FC 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Moses Simon (Paris FC) is booked for saying more than Benoit Millot was willing to tolerate.
90+4' Paris FC failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+1' Benoit Millot sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The Toulouse players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
87' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
87' 1 - 1 Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the top left corner. The score is 1:1.
86' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Pape Demba will be replaced by Mario Sauer (Toulouse).
85' Stephane Gilli prepares a substitution. Ilan Kebbal is replaced by Moses Simon (Paris FC).
83' Corner kicks – 11:2.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ciro Immobile departs the field of play to be replaced by Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC).
79' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Toulouse.

79' Pape Demba (Toulouse) sends a direct shot in from a dangerously positioned free kick. The ball sails to the top left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a quick save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Toulouse.
77' Otavio (Paris FC) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Benoit Millot ignores the protests.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.
74' The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
74' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Toulouse.
68' The expression of the referee Benoit Millot is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Kevin Trapp (Paris FC) is shown a yellow card.
67' The game has come to an end for Marshall Munetsi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC).
67' Substitution. Jonathan Ikone is replaced by Luca Koleosho (Paris FC).
67' Stephane Gilli has decided to make a change. Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) replaces Alimani Gory.
64' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Emersonn limps off the pitch to be replaced by Jacen Russell-Rowe (Toulouse).
61' Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) replaces Warren Kamanzi.
59' The ball is cleared after Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Paris FC.
57' The ball goes out of play and Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Toulouse work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
54' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
54' It will be a corner kick for Paris FC.
50' Pape Demba (Toulouse) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Paris FC.

50' Toulouse are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
49' Benoit Millot has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marshall Munetsi (Paris FC).
47' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The linesman signals a throw-in for Toulouse.
47' The Toulouse players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' A yellow card for a tackle by Diego Coppola (Paris FC). Benoit Millot doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
43' The Paris FC players are exchanging some short passes.
39' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Alimani Gory sets up Marshall Munetsi (Paris FC) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
37' The game is interrupted now, Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) for a tough tackle.
34' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
31' 55:45 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
26' Great teamplay by Toulouse as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
25' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
24' The goal by Toulouse is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
24' Wait! Referee Benoit Millot has indicated he is going to review the Toulouse goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
23' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low shot that goes into the middle of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
21' The free kick from long range, taken by Paris FC, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
20' Paris FC keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
16' Now Toulouse have a corner.
11' Paris FC can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' The linesman makes the right call and Toulouse will have a corner.
7' A dangerous looking corner kick from Pape Demba (Toulouse) is cleared to safety by the defence.
6' Close! Pape Demba (Toulouse) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
6' The game is pretty dull as Paris FC are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
5' Benoit Millot interrupts the game. One of the players from Paris FC won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
3' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
